cli.app_help: Igikoresho cyo gusuzuma urusobe kigamije kuvumbura SSH, SNMP, MySQL, HTTP na HTTPS
cli.credentials_warning: {output} irimo amakuru y'ibanga ya SNMP; yibike mu ibanga kandi uyisibe nyuma yo kuyikoresha
cli.format_needs_output: --format {format} isaba --output; json gusa niyo ishobora koherezwa kuri stdout
cli.lang_help: Kode y'ururimi rw'ubutumwa bwa CLI (isimbura LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG)
cli.partial_warning: {label} ikomoka ku isuzuma ryahagaritswe na --deadline; mudasobwa itagezeho ntizirimo
cli.scan_incomplete: Ikosa: isuzuma ryahagaze ku gihe ntarengwa cya {deadline}s nyuma ya mudasobwa {count}; raporo yashyizweho ko ituzuye kandi nta mateka cyangwa ibika ry'imiterere byanditswe
cli.secret_both_set: byombi {env} na {flag}-file byashyizweho; koresha kimwe gusa
cli.secret_cli_refused: {flag} nticyemerwa kuko agaciro gatangiwe ku murongo w'amategeko kagaragara ku rutonde rwa porogaramu ziri gukora; shyiraho {env} cyangwa ukoreshe {flag}-file
cli.unknown_extension: Umugereka wa dosiye utazwi {extension}, hakoreshejwe JSON nk'ibisanzwe
cli.version_tagline: Igikoresho kigezweho cyo gusuzuma urusobe cyubatswe na Python 3.12+
